still_open.lead: $values reference envelope -- the sibling shape the author blocked ANYWHERE in the tree (index.js:143 containsArrayReferenceEnvelope). By the blocked-sibling rule the author tested it and it worked. resolveReferences.js:39 gives it a different recursion path: obj = obj.$values.map(recurse), and Array.prototype.map calls recurse(element, index, array), so prop becomes a NUMBER and parent an ARRAY where every other path passes a key name and an object; the plain-array branch additionally passes the OUTER prop down.
still_open.falsifier: send {"$id":"r","$values":[...]} straight to a LOCAL jsreport /api/report, bypassing the app check, and diff what resolveReferences produces against the object path. If data merely becomes an Array that request.js already handles (Object.assign(Array.isArray(dataInput) ? [] : {}, ...)), the lead is dead.

honest_conclusion: Unsolved. Under the stock handout every route to the HMAC key was closed by measurement, and the one working chain needs a store entity the deploy does not create. Two things were never established: whether the deployed instance matches the local rebuild, and what $values buys. The unreachability was proven against a LOCAL REBUILD, not against the real instance.
